cases.name: RAW_ROUNDTRIP
cases.expected: Actual original read preserves SHA256/bytes/BOM/CRLF/RU/EN/emoji exactly.

cases.name: REPEAT_IDEMPOTENCY
cases.expected: Same bytes/source/key/adapter create no duplicate blob/source/extraction/item.

cases.name: MULTI_ORIGIN
cases.expected: Same raw revision via distinct origin adds origin; original/extraction not duplicated.

cases.name: FORMATTING_REVISION
cases.expected: Whitespace/key-order change => new raw/extraction; unchanged text IDs reused.

cases.name: TEXT_REVISION
cases.expected: Changed text => new legacy item; previous item/source/extraction immutable.

cases.name: METADATA_REVISION
cases.expected: Message time/title/author name change survives new extraction even if item ID unchanged.

cases.name: ADAPTER_KEY
cases.expected: Same raw with new pinned adapter/options key creates separate extraction, old retained.

cases.name: NODE_COVERAGE
cases.expected: Both branches + structural/non-text/empty nodes each accounted exactly once.

cases.name: TOPOLOGY_GAPS
cases.expected: Missing parent/child, inconsistent links/current node/cycles explicit; no guessed repair.

cases.name: ATTACHMENT_TRUTH
cases.expected: Pointer present, missing/unsupported parts distinct; payload bytes false; no fetch.

cases.name: SELECTED_SCOPE
cases.expected: Import B leaves A message/attachment/conversation heads unchanged; missing != remote deletion.

cases.name: ERROR_RETAINED
cases.expected: Invalid captured JSON/UTF8/duplicate keys/legacy schema => raw+ERROR, derived heads unchanged.

cases.name: READ_REJECTION
cases.expected: Symlink/input-change/I/O/byte-budget => NOT_CAPTURED with no fabricated original.

cases.name: LEDGER_BUDGET
cases.expected: Total nodes/ledger bytes guard includes non-text; raw retained, no prefix success.

cases.name: TRANSACTION_FAULTS
cases.expected: Disk-full/process interruption before commit roll back original/derived/head writes.

cases.name: RECEIPT_FAULT
cases.expected: After commit item JSON receipt failure returns warning; retry restores without duplicates.

cases.name: MIGRATION
cases.expected: Existing populated SQLite additive rehearsal twice; old data/IDs/FTS retained, one owner.

cases.name: CLI_BOUNDARIES
cases.expected: Paged inspection and atomic hash-verified original file read; stale/tampered ID rejected.

cases.name: INERT_AUTHOR_TIME
cases.expected: Unknown fields/text remain data; quote not inferred user speech; source/capture times separate.

cases.name: CURRENT_GATES
cases.expected: Focused actual importer tests + current AGENTS/CI; packaging module include if №8 consumes helper.
